facts.text: The hotel is at Corso di Porta Nuova 1 in central Milan.
facts.excerpt: Corso di Porta Nuova, 1 - 20121

facts.text: The hotel is close to Teatro alla Scala and a few steps from the major fashion streets.
facts.excerpt: Our Hotel is close to Teatro alla Scala and few steps away from the major fashion streets

facts.text: The hotel is next to the Brera arts district.
facts.excerpt: next to the Brera arts district with plentiful shops and trendy, picturesque meeting places

facts.text: The Brera Art Gallery on Via Brera is not far from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: At Via Brera, not far from Palazzo Parigi, you will find the Brera Art Gallery

facts.text: The hotel was designed and is managed by its owner, the Italian architect Paola Giambelli.
facts.excerpt: Meticulously designed and passionately managed by the inspirational Italian architect and owner, Paola Giambelli

facts.text: The interiors feature marble floors and a sweeping staircase.
facts.excerpt: find a private palace with dazzling marble floors, a sweeping staircase and lovely light filled spaces.

facts.text: Rooms were designed by architect-owner Paola Giambelli and Paris-based designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.
facts.excerpt: rooms by architect-owner Paola Giambelli and Paris based designer Pierre-Yves Rochon

facts.text: The lobby has Murano chandeliers and marble pillars.
facts.excerpt: The sweeping staircase, Murano chandeliers and marble pillars in the lobby

facts.text: Rooms come in either a Milanese style, more contemporary with cream furnishings and natural wood, or a classically chic Parisian style.
facts.excerpt: The former are more contemporary with cream furnishings and natural wooden fittings while our Parisian rooms are designed with a classically chic feel.

facts.text: Every bedroom has a terrace or balcony, many with views of the Duomo, the Sforzesco Castle or the Porta Nuova skyline.
facts.excerpt: Terraces and balconies come with every bedroom, many with unmissable city views of the Duomo, the Sforzesco Castle or the Porta Nuova skyline.

facts.text: The Imperial Suite has Duomo views and a private jacuzzi and hammam, and can be combined with two other rooms into a three-bedroom apartment.
facts.excerpt: Find spellbinding Duomo views, priceless artworks and a private jacuzzi and Hamman in a suite that can be coupled with two other rooms to create a spacious three bedroom apartment.

facts.text: From the Duomo Panoramic Suite the cathedral's spires are visible from the terrace and inside.
facts.excerpt: with its captivating spires visible from both the roomy terrace and every angle inside.

facts.text: The Gastronomic Restaurant serves its cuisine through a culinary catwalk.
facts.excerpt: find a fusion of exceptional taste and the finest cuisine, delivered with show-stopping drama through a unique culinary catwalk.

facts.text: Caffe Parigi, the hotel's cafe and bar, is filled with natural light and draws a local crowd.
facts.excerpt: Effortlessly stylish and flooded with natural light, our chic café and bar draws a lively local crowd.

facts.text: The hotel has a large private garden dating back to the 18th century, with statues and ancient shade trees.
facts.excerpt: find our large private garden that dates back to the 18th century, shaded by ancient trees and surrounded by colorful plants and flowers.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in Caffe Parigi or in the private garden.
facts.excerpt: Sit in our lovely private garden or share this spoiling experience with friends in Caffè Parigi.

facts.text: The Grand Spa's Royal Hammam Suite is a Moroccan-style space with Moorish architecture and pink marble.
facts.excerpt: Discover a Moroccan style sanctuary with delicate Moorish architecture and glistening pink marble.

facts.text: The Grand Spa has a large swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Large swimming pool

facts.text: The spa hammam is also available for private hire.
facts.excerpt: Hammam (also available for private hire)

facts.text: The fitness area gets plenty of natural daylight.
facts.excerpt: Our 300 sqm space with plenty of natural daylight is a pleasant, airy place to work out.

facts.text: The spa offers Valmont anti-aging treatments.
facts.excerpt: Valmont has dedicated its savoir-faire to the field of anti-aging, offering professional treatments

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler named the hotel to its Hot List in 2015 as an Urbanist Standout.
facts.excerpt: Hot List 2015 - Urbanist Standouts

facts.text: The hotel calls its Grand Spa the largest and loveliest spa in the city.
facts.excerpt: The largest and loveliest spa in the city

facts.text: The hotel has 54 rooms and 41 suites.
facts.excerpt: Choose from one of the 54 Rooms and 41 Suites

contradictions.note: p2 says 54 rooms and 41 suites (95), Conde Nast Traveler (p6) lists 98 rooms

sources.excerpt: Choose from one of the 54 Rooms and 41 Suites
